img.caption: Fig 2: Main results across CLINC150 / MixATIS / MixSNIPS (unified protocol v1.0). Left: Set IoU (Jaccard); right: avg predicted set size on log scale. CICC (split CP on BERT) and MULACONF (powerset conformal) trade coverage for huge sets (4.5-150 intents, up to 748 on MixATIS tree variant) and their CLINC150 Jaccard is not meaningful. QP-OneModel 10-shot emits 4.2-4.9 candidates yet trails Ours on multi-intent IoU. Ours attains the best multi-intent IoU on MixSNIPS (0.757) with tight sets of 1.5-1.8 intents, requiring no task-specific training.
